headline: Ethereum Draft Targets Four-Minute Transaction Settlement to Cut Transfer Costs
summary: A new Ethereum proposal aims to cut transaction settlement time fourfold to four minutes. The reduction seeks to free up capital that money transfer services tie up while waiting for customer payments to clear.
why: Ethereum is the leading smart-contract blockchain network supporting decentralized finance, stablecoin transfers, and institutional asset tokenization.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Faster transaction finality reduces working capital requirements and enhances network efficiency for financial transfers.
